title: Repair a single pass
prompt: Return the largest number in values. The array has at least one number, and the numbers may be negative. Use one loop.
hints: Which check fails, and what is special about its numbers?
The starting value of best must be a number that is really in the array.
Start best at values[0] instead of 0.

rules.name: max
rules.message: Write the loop yourself. Do not call Math.max.

checkLabels: A single number is the largest.
The largest may be in the middle.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Starts from 0, which is larger than every negative number.
Compares each number with the one before it, not with the best so far.

feedback: Find the check that fails and trace the loop by hand with those numbers. Watch what best holds before the first comparison.
